summary.text: Shane Wilkin is a Republican state senator from Ohio who has represented District 17 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner and former Highland County commissioner, he previously served in the Ohio House.

paragraphs.text: Shane Wilkin lives near Hillsboro, Ohio.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner and a licensed real estate agent.
He served three terms as a Highland County commissioner and was chairman of the Ohio Valley Regional Development Commission.
Wilkin represented District 91 in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2018 to 2022, and he took office in the Ohio Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Bob Peterson.
In the House he chaired the Government Oversight Committee in 2021–2022.
In the Senate in 2023–2024 he was vice chair of the Small Business and Economic Opportunity Committee.
He advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Brian Deer in the general election.
